forensics_request.source:
={{
JSON.stringify({
  model: "google/gemini-2.5-pro",

  messages: [
    {
      role: "user",
      content: [
        {
          type: "video_url",
          video_url: {
            url:
              $('Prepare Reference Media').first().json.reference_video_url
          }
        },

        {
          type: "text",

          text:
            "Analyze this SOURCE VIDEO as a precise reconstruction blueprint for AI video generation.\n\n" +

            "Return ONLY valid JSON.\n\n" +

            "TARGET CHARACTER MODE:\n" +
            $('Build Recreation Context').first().json.character_mode +
            "\n\n" +

            "TARGET CHARACTERS:\n" +
            $('Build Recreation Context').first().json.character_name +
            "\n\n" +

            "USER INSTRUCTIONS:\n" +
            ($('Build Recreation Context').first().json.user_instructions || '') +
            "\n\n" +

            "==================================================\n" +
            "ABSOLUTE CHARACTER APPEARANCE LOCK\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            "The TARGET CHARACTER reference image defines ALL permanent physical appearance.\n\n" +

            "Permanent appearance includes:\n" +
            "- face identity\n" +
            "- facial proportions\n" +
            "- face shape\n" +
            "- eye color\n" +
            "- eye shape\n" +
            "- nose shape\n" +
            "- mouth and lip structure\n" +
            "- natural skin tone\n" +
            "- natural hair color\n" +
            "- hair length\n" +
            "- hair texture\n" +
            "- normal hairstyle / permanent hair identity\n" +
            "- body proportions\n" +
            "- physique\n" +
            "- height impression\n" +
            "- overall recognizable likeness\n\n" +

            "NONE OF THESE MAY BE COPIED FROM THE SOURCE PERFORMER.\n\n" +

            "Do NOT describe the source performer's physical appearance as an instruction for Aria or Nicole.\n\n" +

            "If the source performer has:\n" +
            "- different hair color\n" +
            "- different hair length\n" +
            "- different hair texture\n" +
            "- different hairstyle\n" +
            "- different face\n" +
            "- different skin tone\n" +
            "- different body shape\n" +
            "- different physique\n" +
            "- different eye appearance\n\n" +

            "IGNORE those source-person physical traits.\n\n" +

            "Do not transfer them to the target character.\n\n" +

            "The source performer provides MOTION and MUTABLE VISUAL ELEMENTS only.\n\n" +

            "==================================================\n" +
            "HAIR ACTION RULE\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            "Hair-related choreography MAY be copied as an ACTION.\n\n" +

            "Examples of allowed descriptions:\n" +
            "- runs fingers through her hair\n" +
            "- raises both hands to her hair\n" +
            "- brushes her hair behind her shoulder\n" +
            "- tosses her hair backward\n" +
            "- lifts her hair with both hands\n\n" +

            "But NEVER describe the SOURCE performer's hair properties.\n\n" +

            "INCORRECT:\n" +
            "\"runs her fingers through her short curly black hair\"\n\n" +

            "CORRECT:\n" +
            "\"runs her fingers through her hair\"\n\n" +

            "Do not describe source hair color, length, texture or hairstyle anywhere in the reconstruction instructions.\n\n" +

            "==================================================\n" +
            "SOURCE VIDEO MAY CONTROL\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            "The SOURCE VIDEO controls only:\n" +
            "- choreography\n" +
            "- body movement\n" +
            "- pose\n" +
            "- facial expression\n" +
            "- gaze direction\n" +
            "- wardrobe\n" +
            "- footwear\n" +
            "- accessories\n" +
            "- jewelry\n" +
            "- props\n" +
            "- location\n" +
            "- environment\n" +
            "- background\n" +
            "- lighting\n" +
            "- camera framing\n" +
            "- camera movement\n" +
            "- camera angle\n" +
            "- transitions\n\n" +

            "The SOURCE VIDEO must NOT control:\n" +
            "- face\n" +
            "- hair color\n" +
            "- hair length\n" +
            "- hair texture\n" +
            "- hairstyle identity\n" +
            "- skin tone\n" +
            "- body proportions\n" +
            "- physique\n" +
            "- eye color\n" +
            "- permanent appearance\n\n" +

            "==================================================\n" +
            "WARDROBE RULE\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            "WARDROBE MUST COME FROM THE SOURCE VIDEO.\n\n" +

            "The target character reference image does NOT define clothing.\n\n" +

            "Never preserve clothing from the identity reference image unless the source video visibly contains the same clothing.\n\n" +

            "For every wardrobe state visible in the source video describe:\n" +
            "- garment type\n" +
            "- garment color\n" +
            "- garment pattern\n" +
            "- material / texture when visually identifiable\n" +
            "- fit\n" +
            "- sleeve length\n" +
            "- neckline\n" +
            "- top\n" +
            "- bottom\n" +
            "- dress if applicable\n" +
            "- outerwear\n" +
            "- footwear or barefoot state\n" +
            "- socks if visible\n" +
            "- accessories\n" +
            "- jewelry\n" +
            "- headwear\n" +
            "- eyewear\n" +
            "- zipped / open / tied / tucked / rolled / off-shoulder / removed state when relevant\n\n" +

            "If only one outfit exists, describe it completely.\n\n" +

            "If clothing changes:\n" +
            "- create multiple wardrobe states\n" +
            "- assign each a unique state_id\n" +
            "- specify exact time_range\n" +
            "- explain what changed\n" +
            "- indicate whether the change was visible or concealed\n\n" +

            "Also provide one complete natural-language wardrobe summary for every visible target character.\n\n" +

            "Never use vague wardrobe descriptions such as:\n" +
            "- casual outfit\n" +
            "- sporty look\n" +
            "- sexy outfit\n" +
            "- black clothes\n" +
            "- similar clothes\n\n" +

            "The wardrobe description must be detailed enough for another video model to recreate it without seeing the source video.\n\n" +

            "==================================================\n" +
            "DURATION\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            "Determine the actual creative duration directly from the source video.\n\n" +

            "Ignore:\n" +
            "- platform logo tails\n" +
            "- frozen end frames\n" +
            "- repeated loop tails\n" +
            "- watermark-only tails\n" +
            "- unrelated app UI after the creative ends\n\n" +

            "Report creative_duration_seconds as a decimal number.\n\n" +

            "==================================================\n" +
            "SHOT ANALYSIS\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            "Create a chronological reconstruction blueprint.\n\n" +

            "Break the video into coherent action blocks.\n\n" +

            "Create a new shot when there is a meaningful change in:\n" +
            "- action\n" +
            "- wardrobe state\n" +
            "- performer visibility\n" +
            "- camera behavior\n" +
            "- scene state\n" +
            "- transition\n\n" +

            "Usually use approximately 1-5 second blocks where appropriate.\n\n" +

            "Do not duplicate actions.\n" +
            "Do not restart choreography.\n" +
            "Do not invent actions.\n\n" +

            "==================================================\n" +
            "MOTION\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            "movement_sequence must contain literal chronological actions.\n\n" +

            "Prefer an array of objects with:\n" +
            "- time\n" +
            "- action\n\n" +

            "Describe each meaningful movement individually.\n\n" +

            "Do not simply say:\n" +
            "- dances\n" +
            "- poses\n" +
            "- moves around\n\n" +

            "Describe relevant:\n" +
            "- hand movement\n" +
            "- arm movement\n" +
            "- leg movement\n" +
            "- hip movement\n" +
            "- torso movement\n" +
            "- head movement\n" +
            "- gaze changes\n" +
            "- movement direction\n\n" +

            "Include start_pose and end_pose.\n\n" +

            "If a performer is not visible, set visible=false.\n\n" +

            "==================================================\n" +
            "DUO MAPPING\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            "For DUO mode:\n" +
            "- primary source performer maps to Aria\n" +
            "- secondary source performer maps to Nicole\n" +
            "- track the people themselves, not screen position\n" +
            "- if they cross sides, identity mapping must not change\n" +
            "- never merge both performers into one description\n\n" +

            "==================================================\n" +
            "CAMERA\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            "Record:\n" +
            "- framing\n" +
            "- angle\n" +
            "- movement\n" +
            "- lens behavior\n" +
            "- distance behavior\n\n" +

            "If static, say STATIC.\n\n" +

            "Do not invent camera movement.\n\n" +

            "==================================================\n" +
            "TRANSITIONS\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            "Describe visible transitions precisely.\n\n" +

            "Examples:\n" +
            "- hard cut\n" +
            "- door closes / opens\n" +
            "- body spin\n" +
            "- camera cover\n" +
            "- object occlusion\n" +
            "- flash\n" +
            "- visible clothing reveal\n\n" +

            "If wardrobe changes while concealed, explain exactly when and how.\n\n" +

            "==================================================\n" +
            "IGNORE PLATFORM ELEMENTS\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            "Ignore:\n" +
            "- TikTok UI\n" +
            "- Instagram UI\n" +
            "- usernames\n" +
            "- subtitles added by platform\n" +
            "- watermarks\n" +
            "- platform logos\n" +
            "- unrelated end cards\n\n" +

            "==================================================\n" +
            "OUTPUT SCHEMA\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            JSON.stringify({
              creative_duration_seconds: 0,

              global_scene_lock: {
                environment: "",
                background: "",
                lighting: "",
                camera_type: "",
                lens: "",
                framing_style: "",
                continuity_notes: "",
                transition_logic: ""
              },

              identity_preservation_rules: {
                permanent_features_locked: true,
                source_performer_appearance_must_not_override_identity: true,

                allowed_changes: [
                  "choreography",
                  "pose",
                  "facial_expression",
                  "gaze",
                  "wardrobe",
                  "shoes",
                  "accessories",
                  "jewelry",
                  "props",
                  "location",
                  "background",
                  "lighting",
                  "camera_behavior"
                ],

                forbidden_changes: [
                  "face_identity",
                  "facial_proportions",
                  "eye_color",
                  "eye_shape",
                  "nose_shape",
                  "mouth_structure",
                  "skin_tone",
                  "natural_hair_color",
                  "hair_length",
                  "hair_texture",
                  "hairstyle_identity",
                  "body_proportions",
                  "physique",
                  "height_impression",
                  "overall_likeness"
                ]
              },

              aria_wardrobe_description: "",

              nicole_wardrobe_description: "",

              aria_wardrobe_states: [
                {
                  state_id: "state_1",

                  time_range:
                    "00:00.000-00:00.000",

                  top: "",
                  bottom: "",
                  dress: "",
                  outerwear: "",
                  shoes: "",
                  socks: "",

                  accessories: [],
                  jewelry: [],

                  headwear: "",
                  eyewear: "",

                  colors: [],
                  materials: [],

                  fit_notes: "",
                  styling_notes: "",

                  change_from_previous_state: ""
                }
              ],

              nicole_wardrobe_states: [],

              aria_props: [],
              nicole_props: [],

              shots: [
                {
                  shot_id: 1,

                  start:
                    "00:00.000",

                  end:
                    "00:03.000",

                  scene_state: "",

                  camera: {
                    framing: "",
                    angle: "",
                    movement: "",
                    lens_behavior: "",
                    distance_behavior: ""
                  },

                  aria_motion: {
                    visible: true,

                    screen_position: "",

                    wardrobe_state:
                      "state_1",

                    start_pose: "",

                    gaze: "",

                    facial_expression: "",

                    movement_sequence: [
                      {
                        time:
                          "00:00.000-00:01.000",

                        action:
                          ""
                      }
                    ],

                    end_pose: "",

                    props: []
                  },

                  nicole_motion: {
                    visible: false,

                    screen_position: "",

                    wardrobe_state: "",

                    start_pose: "",

                    gaze: "",

                    facial_expression: "",

                    movement_sequence: [],

                    end_pose: "",

                    props: []
                  },

                  interaction: "",

                  transition_to_next: {
                    type: "",
                    description: ""
                  }
                }
              ],

              critical_motion_features: [],
              critical_camera_features: [],
              critical_timing_features: [],
              critical_transition_features: [],
              critical_wardrobe_features: [],

              uncertainties: []
            }) +

            "\n\n==================================================\n" +
            "MANDATORY WARDROBE CHECK\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            "Before returning JSON:\n\n" +

            "If Aria is visible:\n" +
            "- aria_wardrobe_description MUST contain a complete outfit description\n" +
            "- aria_wardrobe_states MUST contain at least one usable wardrobe state\n\n" +

            "If Nicole is visible:\n" +
            "- nicole_wardrobe_description MUST contain a complete outfit description\n" +
            "- nicole_wardrobe_states MUST contain at least one usable wardrobe state\n\n" +

            "If bare feet are clearly visible, state barefoot rather than leaving footwear ambiguous.\n\n" +

            "==================================================\n" +
            "MANDATORY APPEARANCE CHECK\n" +
            "==================================================\n\n" +

            "Before returning JSON confirm:\n\n" +

            "- no source hair color was assigned to Aria or Nicole\n" +
            "- no source hair length was assigned to Aria or Nicole\n" +
            "- no source hair texture was assigned to Aria or Nicole\n" +
            "- no source hairstyle was assigned to Aria or Nicole\n" +
            "- no source face characteristics were transferred\n" +
            "- no source skin tone was transferred\n" +
            "- no source body characteristics were transferred\n\n" +

            "Hair movements may appear inside movement_sequence ONLY as actions.\n\n" +

            "REFERENCE IDENTITY = WHO THE CHARACTER IS.\n" +
            "SOURCE WARDROBE = WHAT THE CHARACTER WEARS.\n" +
            "SOURCE MOTION = HOW THE CHARACTER MOVES.\n" +
            "SOURCE SCENE = WHERE THE CHARACTER IS.\n\n" +

            "OUTPUT JSON ONLY."
        }
      ]
    }
  ],

  temperature: 0.1,

  max_tokens: 12000,

  response_format: {
    type: "json_object"
  }
})
}}

grok_request.source:
={{
JSON.stringify({
  model: "x-ai/grok-4.3",
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content:
`You are the production director for a source-faithful AI video recreation system.
Do not creatively reinterpret the source. Convert forensic analysis into exact chronological segments for WAN 3.0 reference-to-video.

PRIMARY OBJECTIVE: maximum source fidelity while replacing source performer identity with the selected target identity.

IDENTITY IS ABSOLUTE:
- Target identity reference images define WHO the person is.
- Never transfer source face, skin, body proportions, hair color, hair length, hair texture, age appearance or permanent physical traits.
- Source video defines choreography, pose, expression, gaze, wardrobe, props, scene, timing, camera and transitions.

SEGMENTATION:
- EVERY segment uses REFERENCE-to-VIDEO, never video-extend.
- Prefer 6-10 second segments.
- HARD MAXIMUM source duration per segment = 10 seconds.
- Do not split through an important action, wardrobe transition or occlusion transition.
- Every source moment belongs to exactly one segment: no gaps, overlaps or repeated actions.
- Each segment prompt <= 1300 characters.
- Segment prompts should describe actions, timing, wardrobe, camera and transition. Do not waste tokens repeating long identity descriptions; the workflow injects the identity lock separately.

CONTINUITY:
For segment 1+, the workflow also supplies the final ~2 seconds of the previously accepted generated segment as Video2.
- Video1 is always the original source segment and controls motion/timing/wardrobe/camera.
- Video2 is continuity context only: pose, screen position, movement direction, camera, scene and wardrobe state.
- Video2 must never redefine physical identity.

Return valid JSON only.`
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content:
`Build the source-faithful reference-segment plan.

TARGET: ${$('Build Recreation Context').first().json.character_name}
MODE: ${$('Build Recreation Context').first().json.character_mode}
USER INSTRUCTIONS: ${$('Build Recreation Context').first().json.user_instructions || 'Recreate the source as closely as possible.'}
CREATIVE DURATION: ${$('Parse Gemini Forensics').first().json.creative_duration_seconds}

IDENTITY LOCK:
${JSON.stringify($('Build Recreation Context').first().json.identity_lock || {}, null, 2)}

GLOBAL SCENE:
${JSON.stringify($('Parse Gemini Forensics').first().json.global_scene_lock || {}, null, 2)}

ARIA WARDROBE:
${JSON.stringify($('Parse Gemini Forensics').first().json.aria_wardrobe_states || [], null, 2)}

NICOLE WARDROBE:
${JSON.stringify($('Parse Gemini Forensics').first().json.nicole_wardrobe_states || [], null, 2)}

FORENSIC SHOTS:
${JSON.stringify($('Parse Gemini Forensics').first().json.shots || [], null, 2)}

CRITICAL MOTION:
${JSON.stringify($('Parse Gemini Forensics').first().json.critical_motion_features || [])}
CRITICAL CAMERA:
${JSON.stringify($('Parse Gemini Forensics').first().json.critical_camera_features || [])}
CRITICAL TIMING:
${JSON.stringify($('Parse Gemini Forensics').first().json.critical_timing_features || [])}
CRITICAL TRANSITIONS:
${JSON.stringify($('Parse Gemini Forensics').first().json.critical_transition_features || [])}

Return exactly:
{
  "total_duration": 0,
  "segment_count": 0,
  "segments": [
    {
      "segment_index": 0,
      "mode": "REFERENCE",
      "source_start": 0,
      "source_end": 0,
      "duration": 0,
      "output_duration": 0,
      "source_start_timestamp": "00:00.000",
      "source_end_timestamp": "00:00.000",
      "wardrobe_state": {"aria":"","nicole":""},
      "start_state": "",
      "end_state": "",
      "continuity_from_previous": "",
      "camera": "",
      "critical_actions": [""],
      "transition": "",
      "wan_prompt": ""
    }
  ]
}

VALIDATE:
- all segment mode = REFERENCE
- every segment duration > 0 and <= 10 seconds
- complete duration coverage
- no gap/overlap
- no missing major action
- no duplicated choreography
- wan_prompt <= 1300 chars
- source hair/face/body appearance never appears as target identity instruction
OUTPUT JSON ONLY.`
    }
  ],
  temperature: 0.05,
  max_tokens: 7000,
  response_format: {type:"json_object"}
})
}}

wan_initial_payload.source:
={{
{
  prompt: $json.wan_recreation_prompt,
  reference_images:
    ($json.identity_images || [])
      .filter(url => url && url.startsWith('http')),
  reference_videos:
    [$json.initial_reference_video_url]
      .filter(url => url && url.startsWith('http')),
  resolution: "720p",
  aspect_ratio: "9:16",
  duration:
    Number($json.wan_output_duration_seconds),
  enable_prompt_expansion: false,
  enable_audio: false,
  seed: 223456789
}
}}

wan_next_payload.source:
={{
{
  prompt: $json.wan_recreation_prompt,
  reference_images:
    ($json.identity_images || [])
      .filter(url => url && url.startsWith('http')),
  reference_videos: [
    $json.source_segment_video_url,
    $json.previous_generated_tail_url
  ].filter(url => url && url.startsWith('http')),
  resolution: "720p",
  aspect_ratio: "9:16",
  duration:
    Number($json.wan_output_duration_seconds),
  enable_prompt_expansion: false,
  enable_audio: false,
  seed:
    223456789 +
    Number($json.next_segment_index || 0)
}
}}
